description.value: Vidette Lake Nature Retreat is an off-grid wilderness escape on the southern edge of the Cariboo Plateau, occupying the site of a historic gold mine. It offers six distinct rustic cabin accommodations — from the Hudson Bay Cottage to the Box Car Cabin — plus a communal space, with access to 16 lakes, a 200-foot waterfall, and extensive hiking. Reached via 56km of Deadman Vidette Road from Highway 1, this is a genuine backcountry destination that also hosts retreats, spiritual events, and guided tours of the 'Centre of the Universe' vortex.
